newsitem.title: USA: MBNA Corp adds credit card users.
newsitem.headline: MBNA Corp adds credit card users.

text.p: MBNA Corp said on Wednesday that it added 3.0 million new cardholders in the first quarter, or 2.4 million new accounts.
Delinquency on total managed loans was 4.23 percent at March 31, 1997. Managed loan losses for the first quarter of 1997 were 3.75 percent, MBNA said.
Loan losses continue to be significantly lower than published industry levels, the company said.
MBNA does not disclose its total number of accounts, but it has $40.3 billion in managed loans.
At the end of 1996's fourth quarter, delinquency on total managed loans was 4.28 percent, MBNA said. Managed loan losses were 3.30 percent during last year's fourth quarter, MBNA said.
